picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven National Lab and Stony Brook with building a foundation model for the national electric grid — a flagship example of AI infrastructure being applied directly to critical national infrastructure.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant (part of a $60M investment) will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers, one of the largest real-world deployments of AI for global food security.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is among the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, signaling how deeply commercial AI partnerships are reshaping higher education at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative shows federal policy directing AI investment toward domestic critical-minerals extraction, tying academic research to national resource-security priorities.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test case for how AI-generated proofs should be verified and trusted by the scientific community.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory achieves 100x efficiency gains for AI hardware, a materials-science advance that could meaningfully reduce the energy footprint of edge AI devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models reliably — closing a key gap between generative design and real-world manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: USF's new Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing, backed by a $40M gift, reflects the scale of institutional investment universities are making to build dedicated AI-focused academic infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, University of Queensland, and industry partners to make AI data-centre workloads dynamically grid-aware tackles a growing tension between AI's power demands and grid stability.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's new AI technique for detecting microplastics down to five micrometers uncovered previously hidden pollution levels in Swiss lakes, demonstrating AI's growing role as a precision instrument in environmental science.
picks.title: Hidden microplastic pollution in Swiss waters uncovered
